title: Clockwork Sorcery
description: Minecraft modpack that allows for grand exploration with the combination of Create and the RPG Series.
body:
**A seamless fusion of mechanical mastery, arcane arts, and legendary progression.**

**Clockwork Sorcery** was born from a desire to bridge the gap between complex engineering and high-fantasy RPG adventuring. Originally curated for a private group of friends, this pack has been meticulously tuned to ensure that the cogs of industry and the threads of magic work in perfect harmony.

**🛠️ The Core Experience**

**Master the Machine**
> At the heart of the pack is Create 6.0. Build sprawling factories, automated trains, and intricate kinetic contraptions. Whether you are automating your resource gathering or building massive moving structures, the engineering possibilities are limited only by your imagination.

**Wield the Arcane**
> Deepen your power with Ars Nouveau and Apotheosis. Design custom spells to solve world-space puzzles or dominate in combat. The magic system isn't just a side-quest; it is integrated into your progression, allowing you to enchant your gear and your world beyond vanilla limits.

**The RPG Journey**
> Embark on a true adventure with the RPG Series, featuring specialized classes, better combat mechanics, and a revamped gear system. Explore a world reshaped by Tectonic and Terralith, filled with overhauled dungeons and structures from YUNG’s series that reward exploration with unique relics and powerful loot.

**⚠️ Required Manual Downloads**
> Due to platform licensing restrictions, the following essential mods are not included in the automated download since the deleveloper of the mods hasn't added them to modrinths ecosystem. To experience the pack as intended, you must download these .jar files and place them into your mods folder:

  * **[Apotheosis v.8.5.2](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apotheosis)** — The core of the pack's progression and enchanting system.
  * **[Apothic Attributes v.2.9.1](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apothic-attributes)** — Required dependency for Apotheosis.
  * **[Apothic Enchanting v.1.5.2](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apothic-enchanting)** — Required dependency for Apotheosis.
  * **[Apothic Spawners v.1.3.4](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apothic-spawners)** — Required dependency for Apotheosis.
  * **[Placebo v.9.9.1](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/placebo)** — Required library for the Apotheosis suite.

**🚀 Why Choose This Pack?**

> **Curated Stability:** Every mod has been tested for compatibility. This isn't just a "kitchen sink" pack; it is a refined experience where systems like Sophisticated Storage and Create are configured to work together.
> 
> **Optimization:** Featuring a robust suite of optimization mods (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, etc.), the pack is designed to run smoothly even as your factories grow.
> 
> **Immersive Atmosphere**: With AmbientSounds, Distant Horizons, and custom shaders, the world feels alive and vast.
> 
> **Plug-and-Play:** Includes pre-configured resource packs and shaders to ensure the game looks beautiful from the moment you hit "Play."


**FAQ**
> **Q: Does Clockwork Sorcery support multiplayer?**
> 
> **A:** If you want to play with a friend we recommend to use [em4c](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc) that allows you to temporarily expose a local Minecraft server to the internet with a custom domain link provided. Other option is [essentials](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential). Similar to how you can invite a friend to play on your world similar to Bedrock. 
> 
> **A:** A dedicated server-side version is currently in development and will be released following the approval of the main project.

> **Q: Recommended CPU?**
>
> **A:** At miniumum I recommend having at least an modern 6 core/12 thread cpu for **single player** or for an dedicated server computer with 16gb of ram. If you plan to host this on your own pc while also playing it I recommend a modern 8 core/16 thread cpu with 32gb of ram. The modpack it self utlizes 10gb. (More players more ram is needed).

> **Q: Recommended GPU?**
>
> **A:** At minimum an RTX 2060. (Buddy who plays on server is able to run with shaders enabled at a smooth framerate)

**🔧 Technical Details**

> Loader: NeoForge
> 
> Version: 1.21.1
> 
> Note on SkinLayers3D: This mod is included but disabled by default to prevent visual clipping with custom RPG armors.

**Known Bugs**

> **Carry on may cause you to be kicked from world/server**
> 
> When trying to place down an item that has been picked up there is a 50/50 chance it can kick you from the world/server. (Never tested **Carry On** in single player world so results may vary)
